## Checklist

- [ ] The PR result matches the related issue's acceptance criteria.
- [ ] No out-of-scope changes or sources owned by another repository are included.
- [ ] Changed contracts or documentation are updated in this PR or the stated counterpart.
- [ ] Results from executed verification are recorded.
- [ ] No sensitive data, temporary bypass, or hidden fallback was added.
- [ ] For risky work, rollout, rollback, and recovery are clear.
